subject.title: Native apps should inject live widget theme tokens (iOS/macOS/Android)

question: Should native apps derive widget tokens directly from each platform theme system, or should OpenClaw define and maintain one shared native mapping aligned with the Control UI token contract?
rationale: Both paths can emit the existing message, but they differ in ownership, custom-theme fidelity, and future contract maintenance across iOS, macOS, Android, and the web UI.

options.title: Use platform theme sources
options.body: Have each native app derive the snapshot from its active theme values and validate parity with the web contract.

options.title: Create a shared mapping
options.body: Define one shared mapping for native apps, accepting explicit maintenance whenever the web token contract changes.

recommendation.title: Use platform theme sources
recommendation.body: Have each native app derive the snapshot from its active theme values and validate parity with the web contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged widget-theme work establishes the message contract and its intended token semantics.
